source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Right after an enemy unit finishes a Fall Back, Advance or **Normal move**, a **DEATH GUARD** unit of yours may make a [Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move) (at most 5") if:

- the enemy unit's move ended within 8" of the **DEATH GUARD** unit
- the **DEATH GUARD** unit is up to 6" from this model
- the **DEATH GUARD** unit is outside **Engagement Range** of all enemy units

trigger.event: enemy unit completes Normal, Advance or Fall Back move
